text: Implemented pair-space query constructors without a new analysis class: match_coupling, control_coupling, pair_contrast, match_control, and pair_lm_query. Weighted least-squares coefficients compile exactly to axis-bound H; encoding/retrieval nuisance effects, unequal axes, missing matches, duplicate/repeated pairs, restricted eligibility, named contrasts, sparse Matrix H, and rank/infeasibility checks are explicit. Final-H row/column balance diagnostics report observed invariance only. Tests cover independent WLS, exact additive-baseline cancellation for zero marginals, the diag(a)Q column-leak counterexample, dense/sparse equality, and an unequal-axis ER workflow composed with partition edges and correlation operation. Full testthat suite: 995 assertions. Source tarball/vignettes built; final R CMD check --as-cran exited 0 with only new-submission/version and local outdated HTML Tidy NOTEs. git diff --check clean.
